Prenant sa source de l'apprentissage statistique au même titre que l'apprentissage supervisé et non-supervisé, l'AR a gagné en popularité ces deux dernières décennies en raisons de percées aussi bien applicatives que théoriques. L'AR suppose que l'agent (apprenant) ainsi que son environnement suivent un processus de décision stochastique Markovien sur un espace d'états et d'actions. Le processus est dit de décision parce que l'agent est appelé à choisir à chaque pas de temps du processus l'action à prendre. Il est dit stochastique parce que le choix d'une action donnée en un état donné n'implique pas le passage systématique à un état particulier mais définit plutôt une distribution sur l'espace d'états. Il est dit Markovien parce que cette distribution ne dépend que de l'état et de l'action courante. En conséquence d'un choix d'action, l'agent reçoit une récompense. For a first installation, follow [the simple setup guide](setup.md#1-local-docker-installation).
It covers download, Docker, credentials, inspection, research controls and recreation.
This page explains the operating contracts and retained compatibility launchers.

## Run one installation container

The current local path is one `wake` container, one web server, and twelve internal
worker processes called nodes. Three parents (`100.wake`, `200.wake`, `300.wake`)
each have three children. Nodes do not run their own web servers. The installation
controller starts, stops, and routes them; they cannot continue after it exits.
Each node retains its own governed SQLite record. The controller has no separate
writable group research database.

Prepare topics and provider settings, then build and launch from the repository:

```sh
test -f .env || cp .env.example .env
test -f research-topics.toml || cp example.research-topics.toml research-topics.toml
# Configure GEMINI_API_KEY if you intend to enable Gemini later.
# Edit your local research-topics.toml for this installation.
./scripts/wake_installation build
./scripts/wake_installation start
./scripts/wake_installation shell
wake-research --help
wake-research status
```

**Every container launch starts research stopped.** Inspection does not enable
research or Bob calls. The Console and shell are available first;
use `wake-research start` only after inspecting the installation and configuration.
The launcher neither pulls source nor switches branches. VS Code can attach to the
running `wake` container; `/workspace` is writable and the existing WAKE `.bashrc`
terminal prompt is retained.

Open `http://localhost:8080/console.html`. The container listens on port 8080; the
launcher publishes it on host port 8080 by default. Set `WAKE_PORT` before launch to
choose another host port. An iPhone on the same network uses the Mac's LAN IP,
for exa…

WAKE✳︎ GOVERNANCE
================

This module is the mechanical rulebook for WAKE✳︎.

The model is allowed to PROPOSE changes to durable state.
It is never allowed to decide whether those changes are valid.

That distinction is central to the experiment:

    model output = proposal
    governance = authority
    durable state = accepted history

The functions in this file are deliberately deterministic. Given the same
state and the same proposal, governance should reach the same decision
regardless of which model produced the proposal.

A model cannot persuade this module, reinterpret its instructions, waive a
requirement, or edit the rules during an invocation.

A research transition is atomic: an invalid research action rejects that
transition without partial writes. application_policy.py owns the separate
editorial wrapper, which can withhold an invalid final blog while committing
independently valid research. Do not move that exception into the reducer.

This gives WAKE✳︎ an important property:

    failure can become durable information
    without failure becoming durable state.
"""
